name: 02 Explore Catalogue — Filters, search, and count updates

planSteps.description: Navigate to /index.html?page=explore and wait for the auction grid to render
Verify the results count text displays 'SHOWING 08 SELECTED LOTS'
Verify the results count text updates to 'SHOWING 02 SELECTED LOTS'
Type 'Chronograph' into the search input with id 'lot-search'
Verify the results count text updates to 'SHOWING 01 SELECTED LOT'
Clear the search input '#lot-search' and click the 'All' filter chip
Verify the results count resets to 'SHOWING 08 SELECTED LOTS'
